notes: Seed experiment: random (untrained) BoltzmannGPTLayer weights, visible_dim=16, hidden_dim=16. AUROC 0.65 > 0.5 baseline confirms the architecture has a non-degenerate structural signal but cannot match the trained NRGPT (0.921). Contrastive training is required before Boltzmann-GPT can compete with NRGPT on FoVer.
